paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between ST token number C and two metrics: accuracy and inference time. The x-axis is labeled "ST Token Number C," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The left y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", also uses a linear scale ranging from 36 to 43, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The right y-axis is labeled "Inference time (ms)", with a linear scale from 33 to 40, and tick labels at intervals of 1. A blue line with circular markers represents accuracy, using a solid style. It starts just below 37% at x=0, peaks at about 42.5% around x=20, and ends at roughly 42% at x=30. A red line with square markers denotes inference time, also using a solid style. It begins at about 36.5 ms at x=0, exhibits a slight increase over the range, and ends at just below 37 ms at x=30. A legend is placed at the bottom right of the plot.
